_what: RUCKUS (the user 9 Nov: Top Rudder's Ruckus, derived from the in-game Rufus so the story plane stays as it is). The airframe and the 80 hp Rotax 912 are Rufus's (Kitplanes: an 80 or 100 hp Rotax; the 582 is an option). The Ruckus's own: movable (automatic) slats, the full span; flaperons - the garage's nearest, plain inboard flaps with the ailerons drooping 20 deg on the flap lever (a full-span flaperon wing with no flaps is a garage gap); Beringer brakes - single-caliper discs; 26-inch Airstreak bush wheels (0.33 m radius, tundra balloon carcass); the locking tailwheel; Oratex fabric - no paint (bare, as Rufus); the second fuel tank - a second 16 L vessel behind the seat. No ballistic parachute row exists (a garage gap).
